accepted.s: As per the Socio-Economic Survey 2025-26, the number of Fair Price Shops in Andhra Pradesh is approximately:
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh had 29,796 Fair Price Shops according to the Socio-Economic Survey 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Use the exact numerical value rather than approximating the figure.
accepted.sec: Public distribution system in AP - fair price shops, e-PDS, Mana Biyyam, door delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding ration cards and beneficiaries in Andhra Pradesh during 2025-26:
1. There were 1.48 crore ration cards.
2. The number of beneficiaries was 4.35 crore.
3. Aadhaar seeding covered 98% of the cards.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: Andhra Pradesh had 1.48 crore ration cards, 4.35 crore beneficiaries and 98% Aadhaar seeding of cards.
accepted.tq: Combine closely related numerical indicators and test all three statements.
accepted.sec: Public distribution system in AP - fair price shops, e-PDS, Mana Biyyam, door delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the coverage of Priority Household (PHH) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) cards in Andhra Pradesh?
o: PHH: 139.40 lakh cards and 22.96 lakh people; AAY: 8.67 lakh cards and 411.91 lakh people
PHH: 8.67 lakh cards and 22.96 lakh people; AAY: 139.40 lakh cards and 411.91 lakh people
PHH: 411.91 lakh cards and 139.40 lakh people; AAY: 22.96 lakh cards and 8.67 lakh people
PHH: 139.40 lakh cards and 411.91 lakh people; AAY: 8.67 lakh cards and 22.96 lakh people
accepted.x: PHH cards numbered 139.40 lakh and covered 411.91 lakh people. AAY cards numbered 8.67 lakh and covered 22.96 lakh people.
accepted.tq: Match each category with both its card count and beneficiary count.
accepted.sec: Public distribution system in AP - fair price shops, e-PDS, Mana Biyyam, door delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The monthly rice allocation under the public distribution system in Andhra Pradesh for 2025-26 was:
o: 4.36 lakh metric tonnes
1.36 lakh metric tonnes
2.36 lakh metric tonnes
3.26 lakh metric tonnes
accepted.x: The monthly rice allocation was 2.36 lakh metric tonnes during 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact allocation figure from close numerical alternatives.
accepted.sec: Public distribution system in AP - fair price shops, e-PDS, Mana Biyyam, door delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the public distribution system in Andhra Pradesh, which one of the following is correctly stated?
o: PHH households receive 5 kg per person and AAY households receive 35 kg per card.
PHH households receive 35 kg per person and AAY households receive 5 kg per card.
Both PHH and AAY households receive 5 kg per person.
Both PHH and AAY households receive 35 kg per card.
accepted.x: The entitlement is 5 kg per person for PHH beneficiaries and 35 kg per card for AAY beneficiaries.
accepted.tq: Test the reversed comparison between PHH and AAY entitlements.
accepted.sec: Public distribution system in AP - fair price shops, e-PDS, Mana Biyyam, door delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs relating to subsidised commodities in Andhra Pradesh is NOT correctly matched?
o: Sugar for AAY — ₹13.50 per kg
Wheat atta — ₹20 per kg
Sugar for PHH — ₹17 per kg
Ragi and jowar — ₹20 per kg up to 3 kg
accepted.x: Ragi and jowar up to 3 kg are provided free, not at ₹20 per kg. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the incorrectly stated price or entitlement among closely related commodities.
accepted.sec: Public distribution system in AP - fair price shops, e-PDS, Mana Biyyam, door delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The fortified rice distributed through the public distribution system in Andhra Pradesh is fortified with:
o: Protein, potassium and Vitamin D
Iron, Vitamin B12 and folic acid
Calcium, Vitamin C and iodine
Vitamin A, zinc and calcium
accepted.x: The free Sortex fortified rice contains iron, Vitamin B12 and folic acid.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact composition of a welfare commodity.
accepted.sec: Public distribution system in AP - fair price shops, e-PDS, Mana Biyyam, door delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Mana Biyyam, introduced in Andhra Pradesh in 2013, provided BPL families with:
o: Free rice without biometric authentication
Fine rice at ₹5 per kg up to 35 kg per family
Fine rice at ₹1 per kg, subject to a ceiling of 20 kg per family
Wheat at ₹1 per kg without any family ceiling
accepted.x: Mana Biyyam provided fine rice at ₹1 per kg to BPL families, with a maximum of 20 kg per family.
accepted.tq: Link the scheme with its year, beneficiary group, price and quantity ceiling.
accepted.sec: Public distribution system in AP - fair price shops, e-PDS, Mana Biyyam, door delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Door delivery of ration commodities to remote and tribal habitations in Andhra Pradesh used how many Mobile Dispensing Units according to APSES 2024-25?
accepted.x: Door delivery used 9,260 Mobile Dispensing Units for remote and tribal habitations according to APSES 2024-25.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact service-delivery infrastructure figure.
accepted.sec: Public distribution system in AP - fair price shops, e-PDS, Mana Biyyam, door delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Deepam-2:
1. It provides three free LPG cylinders a year.
2. It had 1.84 crore beneficiaries.
3. An expenditure of ₹1,554.06 crore was recorded during April-December 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: Deepam-2 provides three free LPG cylinders annually, covers 1.84 crore beneficiaries and involved ₹1,554.06 crore during April-December 2025.
accepted.tq: Test the scheme through its benefit, coverage and expenditure figures.
accepted.sec: Public distribution system in AP - fair price shops, e-PDS, Mana Biyyam, door delivery  [APPSC]

accepted.s: DWCRA stands for:
o: Development of Women Cooperatives and Regional Associations
Development of Women and Children in Rural Areas
Department of Women and Community Rural Assistance
Development of Welfare Corporations in Rural Andhra
accepted.x: DWCRA means Development of Women and Children in Rural Areas. It was introduced in 1982-83 as a sub-scheme of IRDP.
accepted.tq: Test the exact expansion of a frequently confused programme acronym.
accepted.sec: Women's SHG and livelihood programmes - full form, purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the relationship between Velugu and DWCRA?
o: Velugu was merged with DWCRA as Indira Kranthi Patham and is run by SERP.
Velugu replaced DWCRA and is administered by the Reserve Bank of India.
DWCRA was converted into PMAY and is administered by APSHCL.
DWCRA was merged with Velugu as Stree Nidhi and is run by HUDCO.
accepted.x: Velugu, launched in 2000 for SHG-based poverty removal, was merged with DWCRA as Indira Kranthi Patham and is run by SERP.
accepted.tq: Use the scheme-merger and implementing-agency relationship to eliminate swapped authorities.
accepted.sec: Women's SHG and livelihood programmes - full form, purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Stree Nidhi is primarily intended to provide SHG members with:
o: Full fee reimbursement for higher education
Marriage assistance of ₹10,000
Timely and affordable credit, including loans up to ₹1 lakh at 11% interest
Free houses in rural areas
accepted.x: Stree Nidhi provides timely and affordable credit to SHG members, with loans up to ₹1 lakh at 11% interest.
accepted.tq: Match the programme with its core livelihood function rather than another welfare benefit.
accepted.sec: Women's SHG and livelihood programmes - full form, purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Pasupu Kumkuma — ₹10,000 grant per DWCRA woman
YSR Aasara — free bus travel for women
YSR Cheyutha — housing for poor families
Stree Nidhi — full fee reimbursement for students
accepted.x: Pasupu Kumkuma provided a ₹10,000 grant per DWCRA woman under the TDP government in 2019. The other programmes have different purposes.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among similar welfare schemes by their specific benefit.
accepted.sec: Women's SHG and livelihood programmes - full form, purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: YSR Aasara is associated with:
o: Provision of three free LPG cylinders annually
Marriage assistance to minority brides
Construction of houses in Jagananna colonies
Reimbursement of SHG loan outstanding in instalments
accepted.x: YSR Aasara reimburses SHG loan outstanding in instalments.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact financial mechanism attached to the scheme.
accepted.sec: Women's SHG and livelihood programmes - full form, purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: YSR Cheyutha provides ₹18,750 per year to which group?
o: All SHG members irrespective of social group and age
SC, ST, BC and minority women aged 45-60 years
Only widows above 60 years of age
All women above 18 years of age
accepted.x: YSR Cheyutha provides ₹18,750 annually to SC, ST, BC and minority women in the 45-60 age group.
accepted.tq: Combine the beneficiary categories, age range and annual amount.
accepted.sec: Women's SHG and livelihood programmes - full form, purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project is correctly described by which of the following statements?
o: It is a World Bank-assisted project run by SERP and has five components.
It is an ADB-assisted project run by APSHCL and has three components.
It is a World Bank-assisted housing project run by HUDCO and has seven components.
It is a UNDP-assisted project run by the Department of Education and has five components.
accepted.x: The AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project is World Bank-assisted, implemented by SERP and comprises five components.
accepted.tq: Check the financing agency, implementing body and number of components together.
accepted.sec: Women's SHG and livelihood programmes - full form, purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about SERP and SHG-bank linkage in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: SERP mobilises 8.447 lakh rural women, and recovery is 99.09%.
SERP mobilises 84.47 lakh urban women, and recovery is 79.99%.
SERP mobilises 84.47 lakh rural women, and Andhra Pradesh has 99.99% recovery in SHG-bank linkage.
SERP mobilises 48.47 lakh rural women, and recovery is 89.99%.
accepted.x: SERP mobilises 84.47 lakh rural women, while Andhra Pradesh is reported to have 99.99% recovery in SHG-bank linkage.
accepted.tq: Distinguish exact lakh figures and percentage values from altered digits.
accepted.sec: Women's SHG and livelihood programmes - full form, purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: INDIRAMMA, the housing scheme for the poor, was launched in:
o: April 2006
June 2021
January 2014
April 2004
accepted.x: INDIRAMMA, expanded as Integrated Novel Development in Rural Areas and Model Municipal Areas, was launched in April 2006 for housing the poor.
accepted.tq: Link the scheme with its launch month and year.
accepted.sec: Housing schemes - launch, beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: YSR Jagananna Housing — launched in April 2006
INDIRAMMA — launched in April 2006
YSR Jagananna Housing — launched on 3 June 2021
NTR Housing — TDP government, 2014-19
accepted.x: YSR Jagananna Housing was launched on 3 June 2021. April 2006 is associated with INDIRAMMA, not YSR Jagananna Housing.
accepted.tq: Use the launch-date trap to separate two housing schemes.
accepted.sec: Housing schemes - launch, beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: YSR Jagananna Housing is implemented through APSHCL and provides houses in:
o: Indira Awas colonies
NTR urban clusters
Velugu settlements
Jagananna colonies
accepted.x: YSR Jagananna Housing is implemented by APSHCL and provides houses in Jagananna colonies.
accepted.tq: Match the scheme with its implementing agency and settlement name.
accepted.sec: Housing schemes - launch, beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding housing initiatives in Andhra Pradesh:
1. APTIDCO is to complete 2.61 lakh PMAY-U 1.0 houses.
2. The APTIDCO project is supported by a ₹4,451 crore HUDCO loan.
3. APSHCL, EESL and APSEEDCO are to provide star-rated appliances to 5 lakh PMAY households.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The appliance support is associated with 5 lakh PMAY households, while APTIDCO's target is 2.61 lakh houses backed by the HUDCO loan.
accepted.tq: Test institutional roles, project size and beneficiary coverage in one set.
accepted.sec: Housing schemes - launch, beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following communities or groups is NOT included among the corporations grouped under the EWS Welfare Department?
o: Brahmin
Kapu
Scheduled Tribe
Kshatriya
accepted.x: The EWS Welfare Department groups the Reddy, Kamma, Kapu, Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vysya and EBC corporations. Scheduled Tribe corporations are separately identified under SC/ST/BC/minority welfare.
accepted.tq: Find the category that belongs to a separate welfare grouping.
accepted.sec: SC/ST/BC/minority welfare - target group  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the Andhra Pradesh welfare budget figures for 2026-27?
o: BC welfare ₹23,650.88 crore; SC welfare ₹6,090 crore; minorities ₹51,021 crore
BC welfare ₹51,021 crore; SC welfare ₹6,090 crore; minorities ₹20,644 crore
BC welfare ₹51,021 crore; SC welfare ₹20,644 crore; minorities ₹6,090 crore
BC welfare ₹20,644 crore; SC welfare ₹51,021 crore; minorities ₹3,133 crore
accepted.x: The 2026-27 figures were ₹51,021 crore for BC welfare, ₹20,644 crore for SC welfare and ₹6,090 crore for minorities. The BC department allocation within the total was ₹23,650.88 crore, while the minority sub-plan was ₹3,133 crore.
accepted.tq: Keep total welfare allocations separate from department and sub-plan allocations.
accepted.sec: SC/ST/BC/minority welfare - target group  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Jagananna Vidya Deevena and Vasathi De evena are respectively associated with:
o: Full fee reimbursement and hostel costs
Housing construction and LPG subsidy
Marriage assistance and bus travel
Pension payment and food-grain distribution
accepted.x: Jagananna Vidya Deevena provides full fee reimbursement, while Vasathi Deevena supports hostel costs.
accepted.tq: Distinguish two related schemes by the specific educational expense they cover.
accepted.sec: SC/ST/BC/minority welfare - target group  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Post-matric Direct Benefit Transfer for minority students is available to students whose parental income is below:
o: ₹1.5 lakh
₹2.0 lakh
₹2.5 lakh
₹3.5 lakh
accepted.x: The post-matric DBT for minority students covers those with parental income below ₹2.5 lakh.
accepted.tq: Recall the income ceiling without confusing it with other welfare thresholds.
accepted.sec: SC/ST/BC/minority welfare - target group  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The honorarium provided to Imams and Mouzams in Andhra Pradesh is in the range of:
accepted.x: Imams and Mouzams receive honoraria ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹10,000.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct range rather than a single amount.
accepted.sec: SC/ST/BC/minority welfare - target group  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with the social security pension amount in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Persons with 40% or more disability — ₹6,000 per month, with no age limit
Persons with 40% or more disability — ₹4,000 per month, subject to age above 60
Thalassaemia patients — ₹6,000 per month, subject to age above 60
Widows — ₹10,000 per month, without an age criterion
accepted.x: Persons with 40% or more disability receive ₹6,000 per month without an age limit. Thalassaemia and similar patients receive ₹10,000.
accepted.tq: Separate disability eligibility from age-based pensions and disease-specific support.
accepted.sec: Social security pensions - categories, amounts

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about social security pensions in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The state had 63.12 lakh pensions in December 2025.
2. The monthly expenditure was ₹2,744 crore.
3. Payments are made through biometric, Aadhaar-based authentication.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: there were 63.12 lakh pensions, monthly expenditure was ₹2,744 crore, and payments used biometric Aadhaar-based authentication.
accepted.tq: Combine beneficiary scale, expenditure and payment mechanism.
accepted.sec: Social security pensions - categories, amounts

accepted.s: The AP Disha Bill, 2019 proposed which of the following timelines and penalty?
o: 7-day investigation, 14-day trial and death penalty
14-day investigation, 7-day trial and life imprisonment only
7-day investigation, 30-day trial and community service
30-day investigation, 60-day trial and monetary penalty
accepted.x: The AP Disha Bill, 2019 proposed investigation within seven days, trial within fourteen days and the death penalty. It did not receive assent.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact sequence of timelines and the proposed punishment.
accepted.sec: Women and child welfare - Disha, ICDS, Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa, Mahila Shakti

accepted.s: Which statement regarding the AP Disha Bill, 2019 is correct?
o: It never received assent and was withdrawn by the Cabinet in August 2026 on the Centre's advice after the BNS and BNSS came in.
It was withdrawn before the Hyderabad case because it conflicted with ICDS.
It was enacted as a Union law through the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
It received assent and came into force after the Hyderabad case.
accepted.x: The AP Disha Bill never received assent. The Cabinet withdrew it in August 2026 on the Centre's advice after the BNS and BNSS came into force.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a proposed state bill from an enacted law and track its final status.
accepted.sec: Women and child welfare - Disha, ICDS, Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa, Mahila Shakti

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes ICDS infrastructure in Andhra Pradesh?
o: 25,746 Anganwadis and 257 projects
55,746 Anganwadis and 725 projects
55,746 Anganwadis and 257 projects
57,546 Anganwadis and 275 projects
accepted.x: ICDS in Andhra Pradesh comprises 55,746 Anganwadis and 257 projects.
accepted.tq: Recall the paired infrastructure figures without transposing their digits.
accepted.sec: Women and child welfare - Disha, ICDS, Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa, Mahila Shakti

accepted.s: Mission Shakti in Andhra Pradesh operates:
o: Fair Price Shops in all districts and the 1098 helpline
One Stop Centres in all districts and the 181 helpline
Anganwadis in all districts and the 112 helpline only
Women police stations in selected districts and the 104 helpline
accepted.x: Mission Shakti runs One Stop Centres in all districts and operates the 181 helpline.
accepted.tq: Match the programme with its institutional service and helpline number.
accepted.sec: Women and child welfare - Disha, ICDS, Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa, Mahila Shakti

accepted.s: Stree Shakti, introduced on 15 August 2025, provides free bus travel to:
o: Women and persons with disabilities only
Women and transgender persons
All residents of rural Andhra Pradesh
Women only
accepted.x: Stree Shakti provides free bus travel to women and transgender persons from 15 August 2025.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact beneficiary group and avoid adding later extensions to the original scheme.
accepted.sec: Women and child welfare - Disha, ICDS, Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa, Mahila Shakti

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about Stree Shakti is correct?
o: It recorded 7.1 crore journeys by June 2026, with no change in the women's share.
It recorded more than 71 crore journeys by June 2026, and the women's share of bus passengers rose from 40% to 65%.
It recorded more than 71 lakh journeys by June 2026, and the women's share rose from 30% to 45%.
It recorded 17 crore journeys by June 2026, and the women's share fell from 65% to 40%.
accepted.x: Stree Shakti recorded more than 71 crore journeys by June 2026, while women's share of bus passengers increased from 40% to 65%.
accepted.tq: Check both the scale of usage and the direction of the percentage change.
accepted.sec: Women and child welfare - Disha, ICDS, Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa, Mahila Shakti

accepted.s: Divyang Shakti, introduced in March 2026, extends the benefit of free bus travel to:
o: Persons with disabilities
Only transgender persons
All senior citizens
Children below six years
accepted.x: Divyang Shakti extends the free bus travel benefit to persons with disabilities.
accepted.tq: Link the programme name with its additional beneficiary category.
accepted.sec: Women and child welfare - Disha, ICDS, Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa, Mahila Shakti

accepted.s: Kalyanamasthu and Shaadi Tohfa are respectively associated with:
o: Marriage assistance for poor brides and minority brides
Housing assistance for poor families and minority families
Education assistance for poor girls and minority students
Pension assistance for widows and transgender persons
accepted.x: Kalyanamasthu provides marriage assistance for poor brides, while Shaadi Tohfa provides marriage assistance for minority brides.
accepted.tq: Distinguish two similarly themed schemes by their beneficiary group.
accepted.sec: Women and child welfare - Disha, ICDS, Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa, Mahila Shakti
